routineCoalesceHelp: Keep one follow-up run queued while an active run is still working.
routineEnqueueHelp: Queue every trigger occurrence, even if several runs stack up.
routineSkipHelp: Drop overlapping trigger occurrences while the routine is already active.
routineMissedHelp: Ignore schedule windows that were missed while paused.
routineEveryTickHelp: Fire on the schedule no matter what — the default behavior.
routineActivityTitle: Skip when there's been no activity since the last run
routineActivityHelp: On a scheduled tick, only run if something happened since the last run that finished. Lets a watcher-style routine stay asleep while the system is settled instead of burning tokens.
routineCompanyScopeHelp: Any activity across the organization counts as a reason to run.
routineProjectScopeHelp: Only activity in the routine's project counts as a reason to run.
routineGateHelp: Add a schedule trigger to gate runs on activity. Webhook, manual, and API fires always run.
routinePreviewHelp: Preview assumes the previous run is still in flight when the next fires. Times shown in {{zone}}.
routineNoPreview: No enabled schedule trigger to preview. Add a schedule in Triggers to see how this policy treats upcoming fires.

routineSigningHmac: Send {{timestamp}} and {{signature}}, signing timestamp + a dot + the exact JSON body.
routineSigningGithub: Accept GitHub-style {{header}} header (HMAC over raw body, no timestamp).
